hot.what: clear, about 5–7 °C, dry, S 10 km/h; about 15 °C on return

legs.sky: partly cloudy, little cloud near the coast

summary: Dry, calm Sunday across the route, cool on the Las Pedrizas pass early (about 5–7 °C); no AEMET warnings for Málaga or Córdoba. The Villanueva del Rosario pages were stale and discarded, so the pass is judged from AEMET Antequera adjusted for height.
sunset: Little cloud over Málaga around sunset (18:04).

verdict.text: Dry and calm: Málaga 9–20 °C with little cloud, Antequera 6–17 °C and clear in the morning (about 5–7 °C on the Las Pedrizas pass at 09:45), Lucena 7–16 °C; no AEMET warnings for Málaga or Córdoba. No action needed.
